messages:
eli: Quick check — onboarding 13B-opt-v2 is ready for a smoke. Can people eyeball: weights path, tokenizer pad/eos behavior, continuous-batching knobs, cache policy, scheduler settings, and max_tokens limits? I pushed a config + small PR: https://git.redwood/infra/serving-configs/pull/492

jamie: weights are at s3://redwood-models/13b/opt-v2/splits/v2-shard-{000..007}.pt (note the v2-shard prefix; loader expects `shard-` by default so I added a small mapping in the loader config)

sofia: heads up — tokenizer maps `<pad>` -> id 2 which is also EOS for this tokenizer. If we leave pad unset the runtime sometimes truncates early. Recommend setting `pad_token_id: 0` in ServingConfig and explicit `eos_token_id: 2`. I added a one-line change in the tokenizer patch in the PR.

chen: batching knobs proposal (from load tests): `max_batch_tokens: 16384`, `max_batch_size: 96`, `max_latency_ms: 30`, `continuous_batching: {min_batch_time_ms: 4, max_wait_ms: 12}`. Also set `scheduler.preempt_policy: "fifo"` for steady latency. For safety set `max_total_tokens_per_request: 4096`.

jamie: updated the PR with loader mapping + batching values. CI: unit tests pass, but integration smoke failed once due to tokenizer pad; sofia's fix resolved that locally. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/serving-configs/pull/492/files

deploy-bot: deploy-checker: canary deploy queued for cluster `dedicated-gpu-pool-3` — ETA 10m. Tests: warmup, perf-smoke, kv-cache-check.

sofia: also flagged a tokenizer edge where long-prefix truncation incorrectly drops leading whitespace tokens — added a test in `tests/tokenizer/test_prefix_whitespace.py` (small). Please run `pytest tests/tokenizer -k prefix_whitespace` if you can.

eli: running the smoke now locally: `./scripts/smoke_onboard.sh --model 13b-opt-v2 --config configs/13b-opt-v2-serving.json` — will paste logs.

chen: smoke log snippet from my run: ```WARMUP: completed in 24.3s
KV_CACHE: enabled, prefix cache size=500, hit_rate=0.73
BATCH_STATS: avg_batch_size=42, p95_latency_ms=28.1
```

jamie: LGTM from infra side :thumbsup: no objections. I think we can merge after the canary completes and sanity checks pass.

eli: merging in 30m if no objections. If canary shows >2% error or p95 > 50ms we abort and rollback. Thanks all for quick reviews.
